name: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper Hot Breakfast: Waffles, Scrambled Eggs & Turkey Sausage
brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites by Marriott Salt Lake City Draper (Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Complimentary hot hotel buffet featuring DIY golden Belgian waffles, fluffy scrambled eggs, and lean turkey sausage links—warm, low-residue protein and refined carbs before work.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Make a fresh Belgian waffle topped with a light drizzle of maple syrup or butter, pair with scrambled eggs and turkey sausage (over greasy pork patties), and take a Lactaid if sensitive to milk in the waffle batter.
watchOuts: Choose turkey sausage over spicy/greasy pork sausage patties
Skip the seeded strawberry waffle compote
